INSERT INTO tips (
                amount,
                transfer_id,
                channel_id,
                message_id,
                user_id
            )
            VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            RETURNING
                id,
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at)::BIGINT AS "created_at!",
                channel_id,
                message_id,
                CAST(amount AS BIGINT) as "amount!",
                transfer_id,
                user_id
